evals.prompt: Smoke test ChatQnA core APIs with default settings.
evals.expected_output: Runs core API checks against default base URL and reports HTTP status evidence for each endpoint.
expectations: Uses default HOST_IP 127.0.0.1 and port 8102 when not provided.
Builds BASE_URL as http://<HOST_IP>:8102/v1/chatqna.
Checks /health and /model endpoints.
Checks docs and openapi endpoints.
Reports HTTP_STATUS evidence for each check.

evals.prompt: Service might be down. Start deployment if needed, then run API smoke tests.
evals.expected_output: Includes container startup prerequisite before endpoint checks when deployment is not already running.
expectations: Includes runtime profile selection via source scripts/setup_env.sh or supported variants.
Includes docker compose -f docker/compose.yaml up -d.
Includes docker compose -f docker/compose.yaml ps readiness check.
Proceeds with API smoke checks after deployment readiness.

evals.prompt: Validate /chat endpoint with non-stream response mode.
evals.expected_output: Executes POST /chat with stream=false and reports HTTP status plus response evidence.
expectations: Uses POST ${BASE_URL}/chat with Content-Type application/json.
Sends request body with non-empty input and stream false.
Reports HTTP_STATUS from the curl command.
Includes response body snippet or summary.

evals.prompt: Run runtime API checks for OpenVINO deployment.
evals.expected_output: Runs OpenVINO-specific endpoint checks and avoids Ollama-only paths unless requested.
expectations: Includes /devices endpoint check.
Includes optional or explicit /devices/CPU check.
Does not depend on /ollama-models for OpenVINO runtime path.
Reports HTTP statuses for runtime endpoints.

evals.prompt: Run runtime API checks for Ollama deployment.
evals.expected_output: Runs Ollama-specific endpoint checks and avoids OpenVINO-only device endpoints unless requested.
expectations: Includes /ollama-models endpoint check.
Includes optional /ollama-model?model_id=... probe.
Avoids requiring /devices checks for Ollama path.
Reports HTTP statuses for runtime endpoints.

evals.prompt: Do a non-destructive API validation only.
evals.expected_output: Runs safe checks and excludes document upload or delete operations.
expectations: Includes GET checks such as /health, /model, /documents, docs, and openapi where requested.
Avoids POST /documents in non-destructive mode.
Avoids DELETE /documents in non-destructive mode.
Reports endpoint-by-endpoint pass or fail evidence.

evals.prompt: Validate document ingestion APIs including upload and cleanup.
evals.expected_output: Runs document API lifecycle checks including listing, ingestion request, and cleanup when explicitly requested.
expectations: Includes GET /documents.
Includes POST /documents multipart request when ingestion testing is explicitly requested.
Includes DELETE /documents?delete_all=true cleanup step.
Reports HTTP status and response snippets for each document operation.

evals.prompt: My /devices endpoint fails on an Ollama deployment. Explain and continue smoke test.
evals.expected_output: Identifies runtime endpoint mismatch and adjusts checks to runtime-appropriate APIs.
expectations: Explains that /devices endpoints are OpenVINO-only.
Switches to Ollama endpoints like /ollama-models for Ollama runtime.
Continues requested validation with runtime-appropriate checks.

evals.prompt: Swagger docs endpoint returns non-200. Provide troubleshooting output.
evals.expected_output: Reports non-2xx evidence for docs/openapi and recommends actionable next checks.
expectations: Captures endpoint, HTTP status code, and response body snippet.
Checks base gateway reachability via /health.
Provides one actionable next debugging step.

evals.prompt: Run all API checks and return concise pass/fail summary.
evals.expected_output: Executes full scope checks and returns endpoint-level pass or fail summary with evidence.
expectations: Runs core, chat, runtime, and requested document checks under all scope.
Includes raw command evidence with HTTP statuses.
Summarizes pass/fail by endpoint clearly.
Includes actionable next step for each failing endpoint if any failures occur.
